## Selected papers

- [A Survey on Archetypal Analysis](https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2026.3740133). With I. Epifanio, S. Mair, M. Mørup. *IEEE TPAMI*, 2026.
- [Comparative Insights: Fuzzy Clustering Versus Archetypal Analysis in Vector Quantisation for Blosc2](https://doi.org/10.1049/ell2.70555). With I. Epifanio. *Electronics Letters*, 2026.
- [Biarchetype Analysis: Simultaneous Learning of Observations and Features Based on Extremes](https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2024.3400730). With I. Epifanio, X. Gual-Arnau. *IEEE TPAMI*, 2024.
- [Outlier detection of clustered functional data with image and signal processing applications by archetype analysis](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0311418). With I. Epifanio. *PLOS One*, 2024.
- [A data-driven classification of 3D foot types by archetypal shapes based on landmarks](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0228016). With I. Epifanio, M. V. Ibáñez, A. Simó, A. Ballester. *PLOS One*, 2020.
- [All publications →](https://scholar.google.es/citations?user=-7oHis8AAAAJ)

## Collaborations

- ironArray (2021–2024) — Knowledge-transfer agreement with Universitat Jaume I on new Blosc2 codecs. Paper: [Electronics Letters 2026](https://doi.org/10.1049/ell2.70555).
- Technical University of Denmark (2022, 2023) — Research stays on archetypal analysis for tensors. Paper: [IEEE TPAMI 2026](https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2026.3740133).
- Instituto de Biomecánica de Valencia (2018–2021) — Research collaboration on 3D foot shape and footwear sizing. Paper: [PLOS One 2020](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0228016).

## Software

- [archetypes](https://github.com/aleixalcacer/archetypes) (2020–present) — Author. Python library for archetypal analysis, compatible with scikit-learn.
- [Blosc2](https://github.com/Blosc/python-blosc2) (2018–2022) — Maintainer. High-performance compressor for binary data. I developed its multidimensional array support.

## Background

- Assistant Professor (2026–present)
- Postdoctoral researcher, PROMETEO project (2024–2026)
- PhD in Sciences, FPU fellowship (2020–2024)
- Software analyst at ironArray (2018–2021)
- MSc (2020) and BSc (2018) in Computational Mathematics
